camera.permissionBody: Allow camera access to preview and frame synchronized portrait and landscape video. Microphone access is requested when recording starts.
camera.photoPermissionBody: Allow camera access to take portrait and landscape photos together.
camera.microphoneRequired: Microphone access is required to record video. Photo capture is still available.
camera.failure: Unable to complete this action. Your saved originals remain in Projects.
camera.saved: Both videos saved to your project.
camera.photoSaved: Both photos saved to your project.
camera.partialSave: This take could not save both videos completely. Available footage is preserved in Projects.
camera.partialPhotoSave: This capture could not save both photos completely. Available photos are preserved in Projects.
camera.exportFailed: Some exports failed. Your originals are safe; retry from Projects.
camera.storage: Recording stopped before storage ran out.
camera.thermal: Recording stopped because the phone became too hot.
camera.interruption: Recording stopped after a camera or audio interruption.
camera.heatWarning: Phone is getting hot. Consider a lower resolution or frame rate.
camera.openLatestPhoto: Open latest photo in the photo library
camera.openLatestVideo: Open latest video in the photo library
camera.unsupportedSettings: This combination is unavailable. Choose different recording options.
camera.androidDualLimits: Android dual-lens mode uses its available frame rate with HDR and stabilization off.
camera.hdrUnavailable: HDR is unavailable for this camera or encoding pipeline.
camera.resolutionOutputNote: Actual output sizes depend on each crop; photos and videos are never upscaled.
camera.photoHdrAutomatic: Applied automatically when supported by the selected camera configuration.
camera.photoHdrUnavailable: Photo HDR is unavailable for this camera configuration.
camera.stabilizationUnavailable: Stabilization is unavailable with this camera and recording configuration.
camera.autoSaveToLibraryBody: Save originals in Projects first, then save both photo or video outputs to Photos or Gallery.
camera.storageBody: Your originals stay in this app even if exported photos or videos are deleted from Photos or Gallery. Uninstalling the app deletes originals.
camera.focusUnavailable: Focus and exposure lock is unavailable on this camera.
camera.focusHint: Tap to focus. Drag the sun to adjust exposure. Hold to lock focus and exposure, then tap to unlock.

projects.title: Projects
projects.name: Project name
projects.deleteSelectedBody: The original portrait and landscape files will be removed from the app. Exported copies in Photos or Gallery remain.
projects.bulkDeleteFailure: Some items could not be deleted. They remain selected so you can retry.
projects.deleteBody: This removes all photo and video originals stored in the app. Exported copies in Photos or Gallery remain.
projects.deleteMediaBody: The original portrait and landscape files will be removed from the app. Exported copies remain.
projects.emptyBody: Take a photo or record a video. Your paired portrait and landscape originals will appear here.
projects.exportFailure: Export failed. Check permissions and free storage, then retry.
projects.trimBody: Cuts snap to shared keyframes for fast export. Originals remain unchanged.
projects.trimUnavailable: These videos do not have matching keyframes for this cut. Try another range.
